During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''supply depot''' on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[76,095 Poe]] in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. It consisted of many loading docks and hangars, including [[loading dock G-79]], and the [[Poe cantina]].
